claude_proposed_widenings.name: area.shape.cone
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The area attachment shape is a closed union containing only 'sphere'. Cone of Cold projects a 60-foot cone originating from the caster. No honest approximation with sphere exists — the geometry is fundamentally different and affects which creatures are targeted.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin.self_emanation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: AreaOrigin has two variants: point_within_range and on_primary_target. Cone of Cold's area emanates from the caster's own position (spell range is Self). Neither existing variant captures a self-originating area; point_within_range implies a chosen point, not the caster's body.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.half_of_fail
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-success branch deals exactly half the fail damage, which scales with slot upcasting. Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect, and DamageEffect holds a DiceExpr (integer dice/dieSize/flat). Half of 8d8 is 4d8 at base, but the per-slot increment is +1d8 fail → +0.5d8 success, which is not representable as integer dice counts. Encoding success as a separate DiceAmount would be dishonest about the scaling relationship.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.
